vulnerability.name: GHSA-58r4-6rv3-gfh8
vulnerability.description: pillow out-of-bounds write in the native morphology helper (_imagingmorph.c) when ImageMorph.MorphOp.apply() receives a zero-width image (CVE-2026-112397, CWE-787, High). Fixed only in pillow 13.0.0: aiperf 0.13.0, the newest release, pins pillow~=12.3.0, and 12.3.0 is the last 12.x release.

statements.impact_statement: The vulnerable code runs only through PIL.ImageMorph (MorphOp.apply, match, get_on_pixels); `grep -rn ImageMorph` over the aiperf 0.13.0 wheel (1005 Python files) returns zero hits, so aiperf never calls it on any code path. AICR runs the image only as `aiperf profile --model <text-LLM> --url <endpoint> --endpoint-type chat ...` from buildAIPerfJob in validators/performance/inference_perf_constraint.go (aiperf_entrypoint.py prepends `profile` and adds no flag), and that argv sets no --image-*, --video-*, --input-file, --public-dataset, --search-recipe or --auto-plot flag. aiperf 0.13.0 opens images with pillow in exactly four places, and that invocation reaches none of them: dataset/generator/image.py (ImageGenerator returns from __init__ unless ImageConfig.images_enabled(), and the synthetic composer adds images to a turn only when dataset.images is set, which _build_images in config/flags/_converter_dataset.py leaves unset without --image-* flags); dataset/utils.py open_image and dataset/loader/base_hf_dataset.py, used only by file-backed and Hugging Face dataset loaders; and DatasetManager._convert_media_urls_to_inline, which runs only for endpoints whose plugins.yaml metadata sets requires_inline_media (image_retrieval, not chat). Plot rendering is off: resolve_auto_plot in config/flags/_converter_optionals.py returns False with no --auto-plot flag and no --search-recipe.
